title: AI Builds Its Own Dev Team
script: I asked AI to build a tiny dev team, and gave it one feedback board. Frontend builds the screen. API stores feedback. Tests check it. A reviewer looks for mistakes. All four start from the same contract: create, list, and update a feedback item. The interesting part is where they disagree: [OBSERVED_COORDINATION_EVENT]. The final board [FUNCTIONAL_RESULT]. The team took [ELAPSED_TIME], including [COORDINATION_COST]. [SINGLE_AGENT_COMPARISON_IF_RUN_OTHERWISE_NO_COMPARISON]. Would you use a team for this size of job?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Feedback board with frontend, API, tests and reviewer roles under a coordinator.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: I asked AI to build a tiny dev team, and gave it one feedback board.
Four agents start building. Who handles the disagreement?
One coordinator, four roles, and a real integration test.
strongestHook: I asked AI to build a tiny dev team, and gave it one feedback board.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Feedback board with frontend, API, tests and reviewer roles under a coordinator. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 60–90 minutes core experiment; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Use an isolated feedback-board repo. Shared contract: POST /feedback, GET /feedback, PATCH /feedback/:id with title, status and ID. Explicitly assign UI, API, test and review roles under a coordinator in an environment that supports them. Freeze contract and dependencies. Acceptance: create, list, change status, reload persistence, validation and no console error. Capture handoffs, integration conflicts, elapsed time and intervention overhead. Do not claim faster than one agent unless a matched single-agent run is also performed.
evidenceRequirements: Perform when commissioned; measure coordination, conflicts, tests and final app.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Four Agents One App” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: [SINGLE_AGENT_COMPARISON_IF_RUN_OTHERWISE_NO_COMPARISON]. Would you use a team for this size of job?
instagramCaption: AI Builds Its Own Dev Team. Feedback board with frontend, API, tests and reviewer roles under a coordinator. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. [SINGLE_AGENT_COMPARISON_IF_RUN_OTHERWISE_NO_COMPARISON]. Would you use a team for this size of job?
tiktokCaption: AI Builds Its Own Dev Team. WORTH THE COORDINATION?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Agent graph, real runs, merges, tests, app.
